gecko.visible_surface_condition: textured, porous, flexible, with zipper interruptions
evidence_used: visible zippers and seams on the object sidewalls
gecko embodiment requirement for clean, smooth, nonporous surfaces
gecko.calculation_summary: Force set to max bound (8.0 N) due to complete incompatibility of dry adhesive with porous, rough, and interrupted textile surfaces, leading to predicted slip or detachment.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: The textile texture completely prevents van der Waals engagement for the mushroom-cap gecko pad.
Zippers create interruptions that cause immediate loss of adhesion.
High uncertainty in actual holding capacity as adhesion will fail entirely.
gecko.reasoning_trace: The object is a soft, woven fabric electronics pouch featuring prominent zippers and seams. Gecko-inspired dry adhesives require clean, smooth, nonporous, continuous surfaces to achieve intimate contact and effective van der Waals bonding. The porous, textured weave and zipper interruptions of the pouch violate all these requirements, making the gecko gripper largely incompatible and infeasible for a reliable lift.

evidence_used: estimated object scale and moderate weight of a standard accessory pouch
silicone.calculation_summary: Estimated required normal force = base friction scaling for a moderate-weight textile object (~0.3 kg) using a high-friction silicone pad: N = F_weight / (2 * mu_est). With estimated weight ~3 N and friction coefficient ~0.35, N approx 3.0 / 0.7 approx 4.3 N, adjusted to 4.5 N to account for fabric compliance and potential contents shifting.
assumptions_and_uncertainty: Object mass is estimated visually to be approximately 300 grams.
Silicone-to-fabric friction coefficient is assumed to be moderate (~0.35 - 0.4).
Uncertainty exists regarding internal contents shifting and exact weight.
silicone.reasoning_trace: The silicone gripper relies on high friction and viscoelastic compliance rather than dry adhesion. While the woven fabric is textured, the compliant fin-ray structure and high-friction silicone pad can conform to the fabric surface and engage through mechanical interlocking and friction. A moderate normal force of 4.5 N provides sufficient clamping to lift the pouch securely without exceeding the 8 N actuator limit.

comparison_evidence: gecko requirement for smooth nonporous surfaces vs silicone capability on rough/textured surfaces
recommendation_summary: The silicone gripper is recommended because its high-friction elastomeric pad and compliant fin-ray structure can successfully engage with the textured, woven fabric and conform around zippers and seams. In contrast, the gecko-inspired dry adhesive is fundamentally incompatible with porous, rough, and interrupted textile surfaces, rendering it infeasible.
